product_metadata.title: 500 Removable Freezer Pantry Labels, Waterproof Tear Resistant Removable No Residue, for Food Containers Jars Kitchen Restaurant Storage Organization
features: Practical Design: 500 pcs oval white freezer stickers. Water/Oil resistant and aligning in an easily distributed roll with perforation line, easy to peel off and hand out. Self-Adhesive stickers stick great on food containers and plastic bags.

Premium Quality: Specially made by formulated paper, sturdy and tear resistant. Plus high-quality glue, it will keep your reminder stay tight on food packages and peel off without sticky stain. Dishwasher, Microwave oven, Fridge all available.
Easy to Use: Enough blank space to write different labeling information for easy identification. Apply with a ball pen or permanent marker is recommended. Peel off and stick wherever you want, done!
Food Maintenance: Inner food turned to be easily identified and sortable, makes your meal prep professional and avoid long term storage.
Include: 500 pcs in a roll. Each measures 2.4”x 1.2” for assorted ingredient storage volume and use.
